articles.title: U.S. House bill would erect crypto-theft task force across law enforcement agencies
articles.snippet: New legislation from a bipartisan duo would set up a multi-agency group under the U.S. attorney general to take a lead on cryptocurrency theft cases.

articles.title: Tether leads $1.4 billion funding round in German robotics company Neura
articles.snippet: The investment is part of the stablecoin giant’s expansion into industries outside of crypto.

articles.title: Japan’s parliament poised to pass sweeping bill to regulate crypto like stocks
articles.snippet: The new rules, which are expected to come into effect in 2027, aim to foster innovation and crypto market growth to meet internal and external demand for digital asset services.

articles.title: Coinbase eyes World Cup boost as prediction markets surge: Bernstein
articles.snippet: Bernstein says the 2026 FIFA World Cup could inject billions into prediction markets, with Coinbase and Robinhood positioned to capture a wave of new users.

articles.title: Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: Report
articles.snippet: Japan’s Lower House reportedly passed a bill that would bring crypto under the country’s financial instruments framework, potentially opening the door to ETFs and lower tax treatment.
